title: Count Distinct Values
statement:
You are given a list of integers. Some values appear more than once. Count how many different values the list contains.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print a single integer: the number of different values.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
